widgetsC.power.desc.shutdown: Closes every app and turns the PC off
widgetsC.power.desc.restart: Closes every app and starts Windows again
widgetsC.power.desc.sleep: Low power; comes back to the same desktop
widgetsC.power.desc.hibernate: Saves the session to disk and powers off
widgetsC.power.desc.lock: Shows the lock screen; apps keep running
widgetsC.power.desc.signOut: Closes your apps and ends your session
widgetsC.power.desc.screenOff: Turns the displays off; any input wakes them
